description:
A local-first desktop client for coordinating AI agents with your own API keys.

Monolith brings chat, code, terminals, file editing, and multi-agent orchestration into one desktop workspace. You connect your own OpenAI-compatible or Anthropic-compatible endpoints; conversations, usage statistics, and configuration stay in a local SQLite database under ~/.Monolith, and API keys are encrypted with Windows DPAPI before they ever touch the disk. The interface ships with Chat and Code modes, a resizable right-hand work panel, a real bottom terminal, an optional local PIN gate, light and dark themes, and 11 UI languages. The installer carries an offline WebView2 package for machines without the WebView2 runtime.
Monolith 0.1.0
Local-first Windows desktop client for coordinating AI agents with your own API keys. Conversations, usage, and configuration stay in a local SQLite database; API keys are encrypted with Windows DPAPI.
Highlights
- Chat and Code workspaces with a streaming event timeline, tool calls, diffs, and approvals
- Bring-your-own-key cloud providers plus a bundled local GGUF runtime
- Skills, MCP integrations, workspace source control, and keyboard shortcuts
- Optional local PIN gate, system tray, single-instance startup, and close-to-tray
- Settings pages share one title height, including Skills and Integrations
说明
面向 Windows 10/11 的本地优先桌面客户端。设置页顶部标题已下移，技能与整合分区与「通用」对齐。
